places.name: Red Fort
places.description: The architectural crown of Mughal Delhi and India's most famous Independence Day venue.

places.name: Qutb Minar
places.description: A UNESCO-listed monument that marks the very beginning of the Delhi Sultanate.

places.name: Humayun's Tomb
places.description: The most serene and least-crowded of Delhi's big Mughal monuments, stunning at golden hour.

places.name: India Gate
places.description: Delhi's most iconic landmark, framed by lawns where the whole city comes to picnic.

places.name: Lotus Temple
places.description: An architectural marvel that welcomes all religions with profound, hushed calm.

places.name: Jama Masjid
places.description: The spiritual and visual heart of Old Delhi, most electrifying during Friday Jumu'ah prayers.
places.bestTime: Early morning or just before sunset

places.name: Chandni Chowk
places.description: The most sensory, chaotic, and authentic taste of Old Delhi's Mughal-era mercantile soul.

places.name: Akshardham Temple
places.description: A modern temple of mind-boggling scale where devotion and master craftsmanship converge.
places.bestTime: October to March, late afternoon into evening

places.name: Hauz Khas Village
places.description: Where medieval ruins, a deer park, and Delhi's bohemian café scene collide in one small village.

places.name: Raj Ghat
places.description: A place of profound national pilgrimage and quiet reflection on Gandhi's enduring legacy.

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
